title: Chart raw adjunction commutes with pullback and exchange
statement:
lemma chartRawAdj_classPullback {S X B T T' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : B ⟶ S) (a : T ⟶ B) (g' : T ⟶ S) (wg' : g' = a ≫ g)
    (b : T' ⟶ T) (a' : T' ⟶ B) (ha : a' = b ≫ a)
    (g'' : T' ⟶ S) (wg'' : g'' = a' ≫ g) (wb : g'' = b ≫ g')
    (l : pullback a' (pullback.snd f g) ⟶ pullback a (pullback.snd f g))
    (hl₁ : l ≫ pullback.fst a (pullback.snd f g) =
      pullback.fst a' (pullback.snd f g) ≫ b)
    (hl₂ : l ≫ pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g) = pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g))
    (hw : l ≫ (pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g) =
      pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (n : ℕ) (V : B.Etale)
    (U : T'.Etale) (r : U.left ⟶ V.left)
    (hr : IsPullback r U.hom V.hom a')
    (z : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf
      (pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g) n
      (((pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
        (((pullback.fst f g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F))).obj (op V))
    (z' : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf
      (pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g) n
      (((pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g))^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj
        (((pullback.fst f g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F))).obj (op V))
    (hz' : z' = abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback l
      (pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g)
      (pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g) hw n _ _
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} l
        (pullback.snd a (pullback.snd f g)) (pullback.snd a' (pullback.snd f g))
        hl₂.symm).inv.app (((pullback.fst f g)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F)) V z) :
    cartesianChartClassPullback a b a' ha V U r hr _ (n : ℤ)
      ((cartesianChartRawAdjunctionIso f g a g' wg' F n V).hom z) ≫
      (shiftFunctor _ (n : ℤ)).map
        (cartesianDerivedImageMap f g' g'' b wb
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) =
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
      (abelianFreeRepresentablePullbackSquareIso a' V U r hr).hom ≫
      (cartesianChartRawAdjunctionIso f g a' g'' wg'' F n V).hom z'

proof.text: Use the two pullback projection equalities to identify the apex-to-stage map with the cartesian image projection after the chart source identifications. Inverse-image composition associativity and naturality identify its coefficient map with the chart leg coefficient map. Raw pullback composition then identifies the transported raw class with the specified apex raw pullback.

Write the cartesian exchange as the mate of the inverse-image square isomorphism under the two derived adjunctions. Transpose the pulled-back chart adjunct. The unit/counit triangle identity and naturality of the single-functor and shift comparisons identify the transpose followed by exchange with the adjunct of the transported raw class. Replace that transported class by the result of the preceding step. This is the existing chartRawAdj_pullback proof, including its explicit hw and z-prime arguments.

Precompose the raw-adjunction pullback identity with the single-functor image of the specified free-representable pullback isomorphism, using chartClassPullback_postcomp. Unfolding cartesianChartClassPullback and associativity give the stated identity. This is the existing chartRawAdj_classPullback theorem in CartesianChartExchangeConclusion.

proof_origin.place: Second proof, canonical comparison square. Reuse chartRawAdj_classPullback, which composes the existing raw-adjunction calculation with the specified free-source transport.
